adjudication.rationale: The diff explicitly adds `addMembers` with a `// TODO: should clear the input` comment and the implementation does not clear/reset `this.get("usernames")` after submitting (`this.get("model").addMembers(this.get("usernames"));`). Since the template binds the selector to `usernames` (`{{user-selector usernames=usernames ...}}`), the entered usernames would remain in the UI and clicking “Add” again would re-submit the same string. This is a concrete, diff-grounded incomplete UX/acceptance item rather than a hard correctness break.
